text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

words.gloss_range: vocative opening particle with expanded call force
words.prose: {{ar:يَٰٓ}} ({{tr:yā}}) widens the first beat into direct address before any command appears. Its extended call helps the summons arrive first, and the rare Surah 5 Messenger-address frame links this opening with the same formal address at 5:41.

topics.headline: expanded direct call before command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with a widened summons before the duty is named.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on the layered opening call, the madd-expanded sound, and the rare Messenger-address frame in Surah 5.

words.gloss_range: vocative intermediary that points and alerts before the title completes the call
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) works as the attention-and-vocative bridge that lets the definite title land as the called identity. The reader hears the address delay the named role until the title can complete the summons.

topics.headline: attention-and-apposition route to the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the title is grammatically installed as the addressee, not loosely appended.
topics.reason: The rows identify the vocative noun, alerting particle, delayed title, and boundary shift into direct address.

words.gloss_range: definite role title foregrounding dispatched transmission
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) ranges around sending, dispatching, and message-bearing; the local title selects the sent-transmitter role

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same-root message noun paired with the Messenger title

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّسُولُ}} ({{tr:al-rasūlu}}) names the addressee by the office of transmission. The definite role noun makes the coming command fit the person addressed, and the same {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) field returns in {{ar:رِسَالَتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:risālatahu}}), pairing sent person and sent message.

topics.headline: Messenger title as durable transmission office
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee is named by the delivery role that the command will immediately activate.
topics.reason: The title is definite, appositional, role-shaped, and locally echoed by the message noun; the 5:41 parallel supports the Surah 5 Messenger-address bracket.

words.gloss_range: causative imperative: make the revealed content reach its destination
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ب ل غ}} ({{tr:b-l-gh}}) ranges around reaching, arrival, sufficiency, and completion; Form II selects causing-to-reach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later negated Form II perfect from the same conveyance root

words.prose: {{ar:بَلِّغْ}} ({{tr:balligh}}) is a Form II imperative: the Messenger must cause the revealed content to reach, not merely possess or mention it. The command governs the open object after it, and its root returns in {{ar:بَلَّغْتَ}} ({{tr:ballaghta}}), so the ayah measures the mission by whether conveyance reaches completion.

topics.headline: Form II command to cause the message to reach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is not mere speaking but making the sent-down content arrive completely.
topics.reason: Imperative mood, Form II causative force, the open object, and the later negated perfect all make conveyance the ayah's mission-completion test.

words.gloss_range: open relative object; possible process nuance is secondary to the local relative clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later homographic negator contrasting the open relative object

words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the object as what was sent down, leaving no named subset inside the command. A process reading remains grammatically imaginable, but the local relative clause makes the content reading primary; the later {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) turns the same surface sound into negation.

topics.headline: open object of total conveyance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is left open as whatever was sent down, while the local syntax mainly supports the relative-content reading.
topics.reason: The rows preserve both relative and process possibilities, but QAC and local attachment make the relative object the governing parse; the later negative homograph remains an audible contrast.

words.gloss_range: passive Form IV perfect: sent-down content foregrounded over the verbal agent
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ن ز ل}} ({{tr:n-z-l}}) carries descent, arrival, and lodging/provision imagery; the local form selects completed caused descent
words.prose: {{ar:أُنزِلَ}} ({{tr:unzila}}) defines the object as already sent down. Its passive Form IV perfect foregrounds the received content while the source is supplied afterward, and it keeps the focus on completed descent rather than a staged revealing process.

topics.headline: passive descent defines the content to convey
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command concerns content already sent down, with the sender grammatically suppressed but the source named afterward.
topics.reason: The passive Form IV perfect foregrounds received revelation, while local form evidence limits the claim away from a staged Form II descent process.

words.gloss_range: directional phrase marking the Messenger as recipient endpoint
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:إ ل ى}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-y}}) functions here as directional endpoint marking rather than an independent lexical image

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: outward conveyance command that follows received descent

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) marks the Messenger as the endpoint of descent. The ayah first routes revelation to him, then through {{ar:بَلِّغْ}} ({{tr:balligh}}) requires outward delivery from him.

topics.headline: recipient endpoint before outward relay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Messenger first as the endpoint of descent and then as the relay point for outward delivery.
topics.reason: The preposition plus second-person suffix fixes the destination of descent and joins the from-to transmission channel.

words.gloss_range: source preposition for revealed content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later source preposition marking the people as threat-source

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) marks source rather than partition. The content to be conveyed is from the Lord, and the later {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) will mirror the preposition with the opposite field: human threat.

topics.headline: source of revelation, not partitive quantity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the revelation as sourced in the Lord rather than as an extracted portion from an undefined store.
topics.reason: The rows converge on provenance and on the later source-preposition contrast with the people as threat-source.

words.gloss_range: construct source phrase: your Lord as the relational origin of revelation
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) ranges around lordship, ownership, nurture, and completion; the local construct binds source to addressee
words.prose: {{ar:رَّبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) makes the source relational: it is from your Lord, not an impersonal origin. The root field of nurture, ownership, and completion strengthens the pressure toward complete delivery, while the supplied narrowing variant remains a contrast rather than the local governing text.

topics.headline: your Lord as relational source of the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is not impersonal: the command comes from the Lord bound to the addressed Messenger, while variant narrowing remains apparatus-level.
topics.reason: The construct with second-person suffix supports the relational source payoff; the supplied non-base variant would narrow the object, so it is kept as contrast rather than governing the local reading.

words.gloss_range: conjunction linking the imperative to its warning consequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the command to its warning. The conditional that follows is therefore not detached information, but the negative side of the same obligation frame.

topics.headline: conjunction joining command to warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is attached to the command as the second side of one obligation frame.
topics.reason: The rows support coordination/resumption pressure, with the conditional warning intensifying rather than replacing the imperative.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle opening a remote but statable failure scenario
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) opens a severe but remote condition. The grammar can state non-conveyance as a live warning without implying that failure is expected.

topics.headline: remote if-clause for mission failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-conveyance is stated as a severe hypothetical without presenting it as expected.
topics.reason: The selected conditional particle frames an avoidable warning and differs from the prior counterfactual boundary.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator forming the if-not clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) negates the possible act and puts the following verb into the governed jussive frame. The warning is compressed into an if-not-doing structure before the result is announced.

topics.headline: negated jussive inside the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failure scenario compressed into if-not-doing before the result clause arrives.
topics.reason: The particle negates and governs the imperfect, producing the negative protasis later contrasted with categorical non-guidance.

words.gloss_range: generic jussive action verb with the commanded conveyance recoverable as object
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ف ع ل}} ({{tr:f-ʿ-l}}) covers doing and acting; locally it subsumes the specific conveyance command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: specific conveyance command recoverable behind the generic doing verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَفْعَلْ}} ({{tr:tafal}}) uses the broad action verb instead of repeating the specific conveyance command. With the object recoverable from {{ar:بَلِّغْ}} ({{tr:balligh}}), failure to do it becomes failure to perform the whole transmission duty.

topics.headline: generic doing absorbs the conveyance duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole duty is reduced to doing it: failure to act means failure to convey.
topics.reason: The generic Form I action verb, object ellipsis, and echo of the specific command make conveying the deed at stake.

words.gloss_range: answer particle introducing the result clause
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from condition to consequence. It makes the next negated clause the answer to non-action, not a separate statement placed afterward.

topics.headline: result hinge from condition to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the next clause is the consequence of failed action, not a loose follow-up statement.
topics.reason: The rows identify the particle as the conditional answer marker that converts the protasis into an if-then warning.

words.gloss_range: negator of the perfect conveyance verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier relative object whose surface sound contrasts with this negator

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates completed conveyance. The earlier {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) opened the scope of what must be conveyed; here the same sound cancels completion if the command is not done.

topics.headline: negation of completed conveyance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same surface sound that opened the object now returns to cancel completed delivery if the duty is not done.
topics.reason: The negative particle scopes over the perfect verb and contrasts with both the earlier relative object and the later ongoing non-guidance negation.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect under negation: completed caused-arrival denied
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ب ل غ}} ({{tr:b-l-gh}}) ranges around reaching, arrival, and completion; locally the perfect tests whether caused arrival has been completed
words.prose: {{ar:بَلَّغْتَ}} ({{tr:ballaghta}}) mirrors the imperative as a Form II perfect under negation. The warning says that if the duty is not performed, the message has not been caused to reach as a completed mission.

topics.headline: completed conveyance annulled by failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning measures the mission by completed arrival, not by partial effort.
topics.reason: The Form II perfect mirrors the imperative but under negation, making completion of caused arrival the standard for the message.

words.gloss_range: direct object: God's entrusted message, locally singular with variant scope contrast
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) ranges around sending, dispatching, and message-bearing; the noun selects the sent payload entrusted for delivery
words.prose: {{ar:رِسَالَتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:risālatahu}}) is the measured payload of the negated perfect: God's message entrusted for delivery. The singular reading presents one unified commission, while plural variant evidence would distribute the scope across communications without changing the divine ownership.

topics.headline: His message as unified entrusted payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of non-conveyance is God's entrusted message, with singular and plural readings affecting scope but not ownership.
topics.reason: The suffix is locally resolved to God by the source phrase and construct relation; singular/plural variant evidence is preserved as scope contrast rather than a different referent.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the assurance clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the discourse from warning into promise. It opens a fresh assurance clause while keeping the protection answer inside the same flow of command and fear.

topics.headline: resumptive pivot into divine assurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a structural turn from severe warning to protection promise without leaving the same discourse flow.
topics.reason: The rows support a resumptive reading that opens a fresh assurance clause after the conditional warning.

words.gloss_range: nominative divine name as fronted subject of the protection clause
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) carries worship-authority and turning-for-refuge discussions; locally the proper name grounds divine protection
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) stands first in the protection clause, so the protector is encountered before the threat-source is named. The nominal opening grounds the assurance in God as stable agent.

topics.headline: fronted divine name grounds protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the protector before the threat: God is placed first as the stable agent of guarding.
topics.reason: The nominal sentence and fronted subject support stable divine agency; root-dispute material is kept as authority/refuge resonance, not as a separate local sense.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect protection with the Messenger as object
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ع ص م}} ({{tr:ʿ-ṣ-m}}) ranges around guarding, holding back, preservation, and seeking refuge; locally God actively protects the Messenger
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْصِمُكَ}} ({{tr:yaṣimuka}}) makes protection an ongoing divine action with the Messenger as its direct object. The root image of holding back and preserving gives the promise force: God guards the same you who must convey, while broader preservation language remains bounded by this protection context.

topics.headline: ongoing God-given guarding of the Messenger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices protection as an active divine holding-back from human threat, not merely encouragement.
topics.reason: Imperfect aspect, Form I active voice, object suffix, root imagery, and the 11:43 contrast all support protection; preservation-from-error remains a lexical resonance, not an unrestricted doctrine claim.

words.gloss_range: ablative/source preposition after the protection verb
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) marks the source-field from which protection operates. The people are not only recipients of delivery; in this clause they are the danger-source from which God guards the Messenger.

topics.headline: people marked as source of threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the people are not just the audience but the source-field from which protection is given.
topics.reason: The preposition after the protection verb marks separation from or source of threat and mirrors the earlier source phrase for revelation.

words.gloss_range: definite generic collective: people as public threat field
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) includes sociability/perception discussions, with a disputed forgetfulness alternative; locally the noun names the human social field
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) names the threat field generically as people. The protection is scaled to public human pressure, and the 5:44 recurrence turns a command not to fear people into an explicit promise of protection from people.

topics.headline: generic human field as pressure source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that protection is scaled to public human pressure, not a named enemy alone.
topics.reason: The definite generic noun and 5:44 connection support the public-human threat field; the sociability/forgetfulness root dispute is kept as social-pressure resonance, not a replacement for the local collective meaning.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the closing assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) strengthens the closing assertion. After the Messenger-specific command and assurance, the final clause opens as an emphatic general verdict.

topics.headline: emphatic opening of the final verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is formally strengthened as a general verdict, not a casual add-on.
topics.reason: The particle governs the divine name and launches the shift from Messenger-specific assurance to universal closure.

words.gloss_range: accusative divine name governed by the emphatic particle
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) is the divine-name field; locally the proper name is the governed topic of the verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier nominative divine name as protector-subject

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) repeats the divine name in a new case and role. The same God who protects as {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) is now the governed topic of the verdict about guidance.

topics.headline: same divine name, changed case and predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated divine name moving from protector-subject to governed topic of the non-guidance verdict.
topics.reason: The accusative case under the emphatic particle and the repeated-name pivot link protection and judgment while distinguishing their grammatical roles.

words.gloss_range: negator creating ongoing declarative denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier conditional negator contrasted with categorical non-guidance negation

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the imperfect guidance verb as a standing declaration. It contrasts with {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}): the earlier negation framed hypothetical non-action, while this one states the settled fate of rejectors.

topics.headline: ongoing negation of guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from hypothetical non-action to a standing divine non-guidance statement about rejectors.
topics.reason: The negation scopes over the imperfect guidance verb and contrasts with the earlier conditional negation.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect guidance verb under categorical negation
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) ranges around guiding, leading, and gift-giving; locally the guidance/leading branch is selected with gift-residue as payoff
words.prose: {{ar:يَهْدِى}} ({{tr:yahdī}}) closes the movement with denied guidance. The active imperfect makes God the one who does not guide the described community, and the {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) gift-residue lets the denial feel like withheld direction and withheld benefit while the local sense remains guidance.

topics.headline: standing denial of guidance to the rejecting community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on a formulaic rule: God does not actively guide the rejecting community, with guidance also felt as a withheld benefit.
topics.reason: The active Form I imperfect under negation, direct object, Surah 5 formula, and closure position support a standing verdict; gift-language is retained as lexical residue within guidance, not the selected translation sense.

words.gloss_range: definite collective direct object of the guidance denial
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) ranges around standing, rising, establishing, and people/community; locally it names a collective standing together
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-qawma}}) is the collective object of that denial. The word turns the target into a community standing together, with the following participle locking the reasoned qualifier onto the group.

topics.headline: community object standing in rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-guidance targets a collective stance, not scattered isolated persons.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the guidance verb, qualified by the following participle, and participates in the Surah 5 formula with community types.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle qualifying the community as active rejectors
words.root_gloss_range: {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) ranges around covering, denial, ingratitude, and covering-over; locally the participle names an ongoing rejecting class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening conveyance command opposed by the final covering participle

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīna}}) closes the ayah with an active participial class label. Its covering image counters {{ar:بَلِّغْ}} ({{tr:balligh}}): the message is to be made to reach outward, while this group is characterized by covering and resistant closure.

topics.headline: active covering as the final opposed endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final label as active covering that opposes the opening command to make revelation reach.
topics.reason: The active participle grammatically qualifies the community and closes the ayah in semantic opposition to conveyance; farmer/night/expiation images remain concrete root support under the theological sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَلِّغْ مَا أُنزِلَ ... فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispatched communication descends into the messenger's custody and must be carried all the way to its destination. Repeating ب ل غ across command and counterfactual makes endpoint arrival constitutive of the commission: an incomplete relay is treated as no relay.

activation_trace.role: Joins the commissioned carrier and the carried communication into one relay.
Supplies arrival at a limit and makes actual endpoint completion the test of the doubled verb.
Supplies caused downward delivery as the upstream movement that the messenger must continue.

changed_reading.before: State the revealed content to the audience.
changed_reading.after: Complete an entrusted relay so that what was sent down actually reaches its endpoint; withholding any part breaks the commission rather than merely diminishing it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse coordinates opposite motions: the communication is released outward while its carrier is held against interruption. Protection is therefore functional containment of the transmitting channel, not withdrawal of the messenger from human exposure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies release and outward dispatch as the motion that must remain open.
Supplies a preventing hold that preserves the carrier while transmission proceeds.
Locates the danger in the manifest human social field through which the relay must pass.

changed_reading.before: God keeps the messenger safe from people.
changed_reading.after: God holds the messenger-channel against human interruption so that the message, unlike its carrier, can be released fully into the human field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ ... لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus distinguishes external arrival from internal orientation. The messenger is accountable for making the communication reach; gentle direction can still fail where a collective actively covers the truth, so hostile uptake is not the measure of completed conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Marks objective arrival at the communicative endpoint.
Supplies gentle orientation toward a path as a distinct reception process.
Supplies active obstruction of acknowledged truth as the barrier to guided uptake.
Makes the reception problem collective and social rather than merely private.

changed_reading.before: Successful delivery should be evidenced by the audience becoming guided.
changed_reading.after: Complete arrival and guided uptake are separate events: the first is demanded of the messenger even where collective truth-covering blocks the second.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destination is not passive: a public call can be appropriated into mockery and purposeless play, while an interior posture can be concealed behind a declaration. Complete conveyance must therefore remain publicly legible even when hearers recode or hide their response.

activation_trace.role: Keeps communicative arrival independently testable despite hostile audience transformations.
Supplies an openly raised call as the public transmission exposed to response.
Supplies appropriation, making ridicule an active capture of the call rather than mere inattention.
Converts the received call into derision and thereby changes its social presentation.
Removes serious purpose from the call and supplies a second mode of semantic interception.
Supplies concealment of the hearer's interior state, separating declared reception from actual uptake.

structural_cues: 5:57-58 repeat the taking of religion and the public call as mockery and play; 5:61 then contrasts a spoken claim of belief with what is hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a public call recoded as play and an interior condition concealed; I treat these as two interception mechanisms against which completed delivery must stay independently auditable. A live alternative is that both are only post-delivery reactions and do not affect the shape of conveyance itself.

changed_reading.before: Complete arrival is required even when uptake fails.
changed_reading.after: Complete arrival must remain unmistakable when hearers actively capture the call into ridicule or conceal their response; their recoding cannot redefine whether the messenger completed the relay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Learned office without restraining intervention becomes a countermodel for the messenger's commission. The focus conditional on not acting makes transmission an enacted responsibility: title, knowledge, and criticism are insufficient if they do not interrupt a harmful social production.

activation_trace.role: Makes omission the absence of an effect-producing act rather than a neutral pause.
Supplies the missing act of checking and restraining wrongdoing.
Locates the omission among holders of learned religious authority and sharpens the office-versus-action contrast.
Treats repeated wrongdoing as something socially produced, which responsible speech should interrupt.

structural_cues: 5:62 condemns what people do, 5:63 condemns learned authorities for not restraining what is said and consumed, and 5:67 defines the messenger's commission through the consequence of not acting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed learned restraint and the focus's action conditional; I infer an office-level contrast in which delivery is the messenger's required intervention. The alternative is that the rebuke of learned authorities and the messenger's command are adjacent but functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: Not conveying would leave an assigned communication unfinished.
changed_reading.after: Not conveying would reproduce the institutional failure just exposed: an office becomes empty when its holder does not actively interrupt concealment and harmful production.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus context materializes selective restraint through bound and extended hands, then recurring war-fires and their extinguishing. At the focus, the message is the element released, while divine holding prevents the human conflict field from closing the transmitting channel.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the outward release that protection must permit rather than restrain.
Supplies a fastening support by which the carrier remains secured under pressure.
Provides the concrete image of a limb-binding restraint and raises the question of what is wrongly or rightly held.
Provides the counter-motion of extending and releasing a hand, matching an unobstructed outgoing channel.
Supplies recurrent ignition as the conflict process threatening continuity of transmission.
Names the hostile field in which the protected relay must operate.
Supplies divine quenching as a contextual precedent for containing interruption without suppressing the message.

structural_cues: Within the pre-focus movement, 5:64 pairs bound and outspread hands and repeatedly ignited war with divine extinguishing before 5:67 pairs dispatch with protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint/release imagery and divine quenching of recurrent conflict; I align those motions with the focus's released message and held messenger. The alternative is that the hand imagery concerns provision and the fire imagery communal war without specifying the mechanism of 5:67 protection.

changed_reading.before: Protection is a general preventing hold on harm.
changed_reading.after: Protection is selective conflict containment: it secures the carrier and quenches interruption while leaving the outgoing message fully extended and unbound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is a hinge between recipient establishment and messenger transmission. The same descending material is at issue on both sides, but the verbs divide accountability: the messenger must make it reach, while recipients must stand it up as an operative order.

activation_trace.role: Defines the messenger-side responsibility as delivering the communication.
Supplies active rising to undertake an order as the recipient-side responsibility.
Identifies the established material as the same kind of caused delivery that enters the focus relay.
Repeats active undertaking after the focus and places the obligation in a collective social setting.
Repeats caused delivery on both the recipient and messenger sides, binding the flanking passages together.

structural_cues: 5:66 and 5:68 flank the focus with near-repetitions of what was sent down from their or your Lord, while establishment belongs to recipients and conveyance belongs to the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated descent phrases and distinct obligation verbs; I infer a division of responsibility in which conveyance enables but does not substitute for establishment. A live alternative is that the repetition supplies topical emphasis without a formal sender-recipient division.

changed_reading.before: The messenger alone is charged with completing the movement of revelation.
changed_reading.after: The messenger is accountable for making revelation reach, while recipients are separately accountable for making it stand in practice; their failure cannot retroactively turn his completed relay into non-delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus envoy sequence establishes a recurrent hazard: commissioned carriers bring what selves resist and are denied or killed, while later messengers pass in succession. Protection in the focus therefore secures completion of this relay inside a known rejection pattern, rather than promising an opposition-free mission.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A message exists as mission only when it reaches its limit.** `ب ل غ B001` is reaching the limit and `B002` conveying; repetition makes incomplete conveyance equivalent to no conveyance. I infer that receipt imposes a terminal direction toward public delivery.
2. **Protection is a holdfast enabling exposure.** `ع ص م B001` is a protective restraining hold and `B002` a strap/holdfast. Placed after the uncompromised command, it does not prevent action but secures the messenger while action extends outward.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Delivery is defined by reaching the message’s limit.** Repeated fixed **ب ل غ / B001** (“reaching the limit”) and **B002** (“conveying a message”) make partial arrival functionally equivalent to non-delivery. The preceding ayat concern establishing all that was sent down, while 5:68 makes standing conditional on the same completeness. I infer that the message’s integrity is lost if fear stops it short of its assigned endpoint. The doubled construction reads as a completion criterion, not rhetorical redundancy.
2. **Protection supplies the hold needed for full transmission.** Fixed **ع ص م / B001** (“a restraining hold that protects”) follows the uncompromised command. I infer that divine protection blocks human pressure from shortening the route. Preservation here reads as enabling complete public conveyance, not withdrawal from exposure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:68’s demand to establish all revelation and 5:70’s succession of messengers confirmed that delivery is measured by complete reach, not selective transmission.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel olarak herhangi bir şeyi indirmekten çok, Tanrı'nın iyilikleri ve sıkıntıları kullara vermesini, bildiriyi ulaştırmasını, kimi zaman sonucun kendisi yerine nedenlerini göndermesini ve bildirinin bölüm bölüm yinelenmesini anlatır. Bu yüzden dal, genel ettirgen indirme yerine bu özel ulaştırma çerçevesiyle tanımlanmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, genel ettirgen biçimlerin yanında Tanrı'nın verme ve bildirme eylemlerine bağlı özel yapıları içerir; özel dinsel kapsam yalın biçimin her kullanımına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'nın iyilikleri, cezaları, esirgemeyi veya bir bildiriyi insanlara ulaştırmasıdır; ulaştırma doğrudan şeyin kendisiyle ya da onu doğuran nedenlerin verilmesiyle gerçekleşebilir. Bildiri bölüm bölüm ve yinelenerek gelebilir.

facets.statement: Tanrı iyilikleri veya cezaları insanlara verir ve ulaştırır.
Ulaştırma, şeyin kendisinin gelmesiyle ya da onu ortaya çıkaran nedenlerin gönderilmesiyle olabilir.
Tanrısal bildiri bölüm bölüm ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırılabilir.
Tanrısal esirgemenin bir topluluğa erişmesi bu ulaştırma biçiminin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak içerik, Tanrı'nın yarar ve sıkıntıları insanlara vermesini doğrudan nesnenin ya da nedenlerinin ulaştırılmasıyla açıklar; tanrısal bildirinin bölüm bölüm yinelenmesi ve esirgemenin erişmesi de bu çerçevededir.

error_profile.loses: Bildirinin bölüm bölüm gelmesini ve nedenlerin gönderilmesi ayrımını belirtmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنزال غيره، وإنزال الله النعم والنقم والكتاب والماء واللباس ونحو ذلك، وتنزل الملائكة والأمر، مع تمييز الإنزال العام والتنزيل المتكرر في الوحي.
branches.source_phrase_ar: تنزلت الرحمة عليهم (tahdhib)؛ إنزال الله تعالى نعمه ونقمه على الخلق وإعطاؤهم إياها؛ إما بإنزال الشيء نفسه كإنزال القرآن وإما بإنزال أسبابه؛ التنزيل يختص بما أنزل مفرقا ومرة بعد أخرى (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المنزل والمنهل والدار، المنازل والنزلات، تقدير المنازل، والمنزلة بمعنى المرتبة وحط المرء عنها.
يدخل فيه التنزيل بمعنى ترتيب الشيء ووضعه منزله، أي إيقاع الشيء في موضعه أو مرتبته المناسبة.
يدخل فيه ما يهيأ للنزيل والضيف من طعام وزاد وضيافة، وما يسمى نزلا لأهل الجنة أو النار، والضيف نفسه بلفظ النزيل، والريع والفضل والعطاء إذا شبها بذلك.
يدخل فيه النازلة والنوازل، أي الشدة التي تنزل بالقوم أو بالناس من شدائد الدهر.
يدخل فيه النزال والمنازلة في الحرب، وأن ينزل الفريقان معا للقتال، ولفظ نزال بمعنى انزلوا للحرب.
يدخل فيه قولهم نزل أو نزل القوم إذا أتوا منى، والتعبير عن الحج بالنزول.
يدخل فيه النزالة والنزل كناية عن ماء الرجل وخروجه، وقولهم أنزل ماءه والمرأة تستنزله.
يدخل فيه النزلة بمعنى المرة الواحدة من النزول، وتفسير نزلة أخرى بمرة أخرى، ومنه عند بعضهم النزلة كالزكام بوصفها عارضة.

يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, Tanrı bilgisiyle donanmış, dinî hükümleri bilen, bilgeliği olan ve başkalarını temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştiren bilgin tipini ortak bir kimlikte birleştirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bilgin ve öğretici kişi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka yapılardan anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı bilgisine ve dinî hükümlere hâkim, bilgece davranan ve insanları temel bilgiden ileri bilgiye doğru yetiştiren bilgindir.

facets.statement: Kişi Tanrı bilgisiyle ve dinî konulardaki sağlam bilgisiyle tanımlanır.
Bilgiyi yalnız taşımakla kalmaz, başkalarını küçük adımlarla öğretip yetiştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar Tanrı'yı bilme, dinî hükümleri kavrama, bilgelik ve aşamalı öğreticilik özelliklerini aynı bilgin kişide bir araya getirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرباني: المتأله العارف بالله تعالى (sihah); الرباني: العالم؛ العلماء بالحلال والحرام؛ حكماء علماء؛ العالم المعلم الذي يغذو الناس بصغار العلوم (tahdhib); الرباني... يرب العلم؛ يرب نفسه بالعلم؛ منسوب إلى الرب (mufradat); الربي العارف بالرب (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم
يدخل فيه الربيب والربيبة للولد المربوب من زوج سابق، والراب والرابة لمن يقوم على أمره، والحاضنة
يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به
يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
يدخل فيه الربة والربب لضرب من الشجر أو النبت أو البقلة التي تبقى خضراء
يدخل فيه الربب للماء الكثير، ويقال للعذب، من جهة اجتماع الماء
يدخل فيه الربرب لقطيع بقر الوحش، وقيل لجماعة البقر أو الإبل
يدخل فيه رب وربما وربت وربه كحرف خافض أو حرف معنى للتقليل، ودخول ما أو التاء أو الهاء عليه
يدخل فيه الربى بمعنى الحاجة، والرابة، والعقدة المحكمة، والنعمة والإحسان
يدخل فيه الرباني لرئيس الملاحين

root_profile.summary: Kök, sahiplik ve yetiştirmeden topluluk, aile bağı, kalıcılık, bulut, yiyecek maddesi, sözleşme, bitki, su, hayvan sürüsü, dil bilgisel öğe ve gemi yönetimine uzanan on yedi ayrı anlam dalı taşır. Dalların çoğu yönetme, bir araya getirme veya süreklilik çağrışımlarıyla gevşekçe ilişkilense de sözlükte bağımsız sınırlar gerektirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çocuk veya ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlama ile bir topluluk içinde yetişip gelişme yönlerini aynı büyüme sürecinde birleştirir. Ettirgen bakım ile yetişenin kendi gelişimi katılımcı bakımından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Besleyip büyütme, bunun sonucu gelişme ve bir topluluk içinde yetişme kullanımları katılımcı değişimleri korunarak ayrı gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Çocuk ya da ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlamak veya bu bakımın etkisiyle büyümektir. Kişinin bir topluluğun içinde yetişip gelişmesi de bu sürecin toplumsal yönüdür.

facets.statement: Büyüyen varlık beslenir ve gelişmesi sağlanır.
Beslenen çocuk veya ürün bakımın sonucu olarak büyür.
Kişi belirli bir topluluğun içinde yetişip gelişebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar beslemeyi büyümenin nedeni, büyümeyi de bakımın sonucu olarak ilişkilendirir; çocuk ve ürün bu yapının örnekleridir, topluluk içinde yetişme ise katılımcı yönünü değiştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tutma ve engelleme çekirdeğini; kötülükten koruma, bir koruyucuya tutunarak sakınma, direnip kaçınma ve bir şeye bağlı kalma yönleriyle birlikte verir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu eylem ve ilişki örgüsünü doğru biçimde karşılar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın engelleme ve koruma çekirdeğini türemiş biçimlerdeki tutunma, sığınma ve direnme yönlerinden ayırır; belirli tamlamalara özgü anlamları bütün dala yaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Birini ya da bir şeyi kötülükten veya zarardan alıkoyarak korumak; türemiş kullanımlarda ise bir koruyucuya ya da dayanağa sıkıca tutunup onunla korunmak, sığınmak veya boyun eğmemektir. Bir şeye bağlı kalma ve yemeğin açlığı gidermesi, bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir zararın kişiye veya şeye ulaşmasını engelleyerek onu koruma ve elde tutma eylemidir.
Türemiş biçimlerde kişi bir koruyucuya veya dayanağa tutunur, ona sığınır ve böylece zarar ya da yanlış davranıştan sakınır.
Direnme, boyun eğmeme ve bir şeye sıkıca bağlı kalma, tutunarak engellenme yönünü öne çıkaran özel kullanımlardır.
Yemeğin kişiyi açlıktan koruması, engelleyici korumanın somut bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tutma, engelleme ve korumada birleşir; türemiş kullanımlar bu çekirdeği bir koruyucuya tutunma, sığınma, direnme ve bağlı kalma yönlerine taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın doğrudan koruma çekirdeğiyle türemiş biçimlerdeki tutunarak korunma yönünü birlikte anlatan en kısa kapsayıcı karşılıktır.

Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. branches.branch_image_ar: إيناس الشيء برؤية أو إحساس أو سماع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آنس الشيء إذا أبصره أو رآه، وآنس الصوت إذا سمعه، وأحس الفزع أو وجد الشيء في نفسه، والاستئناس بمعنى النظر والتبصر.
يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.

branches.branch_image_ar: إنسان العين وصورة الإنسان في السواد
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.
يدخل فيه كيف ابن إنسك للسؤال عن النفس، وفلان ابن أنس فلان لصفيه وخاصته، وما قاربه من الخدن والأنيس والخلص والجليس.
يدخل فيه تفسير حتى تستأنسوا بالاستئذان أو السلام وطلب الدخول، أو بإيجاد إيناس قبل الدخول.

Ayrıca insana dönük yan, gözde görülen küçük görüntü, kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını ve eve girişten önce kabul arama gibi belirgin biçimde ayrılmış kullanımları vardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yanılgının karşıtı olan doğru yönelişi, yolu veya doğruyu incelikle gösterip tanıtmayı, gösterileni benimsemeyi ve ilahi başarı desteğini birlikte kapsar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal anlamı tanımlanır; başka dallardaki armağan, adanmış sunu ve özel kullanım anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yolu, doğruyu ya da benimsenmesi gereken yönü incelikle göstermek ve tanıtmak; gösterilen yönü kabul ederek doğruya ulaşmak, ayrıca bunun ilahi başarı desteğiyle gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Doğru yönü, yolu veya gerçeği incelikle göstermek, açıklamak ve tanıtmaktır.
Gösterilen doğru yönü isteyerek kabul etme ve ona ulaşma sürecini de kapsar.
Dinsel doğruya yöneltme ve bu yönelişi mümkün kılan ilahi başarı desteği özel bir gerçekleşmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar doğru yönü gösterme, yolu tanıtma ve yanılgının karşıtı olan doğruya erişme çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatım, insanın gösterileni seçip benimsemesini ve ilahi başarı desteğini de içerir. Bir kaynakta itaat ve sakınma da bu anlam alanındaki gerçekleşmeler arasında sayılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفر نقيض الإيمان وجحود الوحدانية أو الشريعة أو النبوة والإنكار والجحود والمعاندة والنفاق والشرك والتكذيب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفر ضد الإيمان سمى لأنه تغطية الحق (maqayis)؛ الكفر نقيض الإيمان والكفر أربعة أنحاء كفر الجحود وكفر المعاندة وكفر النفاق وكفر الإنكار (ayn)؛ الكفر ضد الإيمان (sihah)؛ الكفر نقيض الإيمان وكفر إنكار وكفر جحود وكفر معاندة وكفر نفاق وكفر هو شرك وكفر بكتاب الله ورسوله والتكذيب بالله (tahdhib)؛ أعظم الكفر جحود الوحدانية أو الشريعة أو النبوة (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları fiziksel örtme çekirdeğinden gece ve suyun örtücülüğüne, tohum ile bitki kılıflarına, dinî gerçeği veya nimeti reddetmeye ve günah yükünü gidermeye uzanan radyal bir yapı gösterir; ayrıca uzak yer, dağ geçidi, boyun eğme, taçlandırma ve aynı biçimli bitki-madde adları gibi sözlüksel olarak ayrışmış dallar bulunur.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
